description: This file defines the Java class `AllergyReaction`, which models allergy reaction data within the OpenMRS healthcare system. It includes properties such as allergy, reaction concepts, and non-coded reactions, along with methods for setting, getting, and comparing allergy reaction instances.

classes.name: AllergyReaction
classes.description: Represents an allergy reaction, including references to the allergy, reaction concept, and non-coded reaction description.

methods.name: getAllergyReactionId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier for the allergy reaction.

methods.name: setAllergyReactionId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier for the allergy reaction.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Implements interface method to get the object's ID.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Implements interface method to set the object's ID.

methods.name: getAllergy
methods.description: Returns the allergy associated with this reaction.

methods.name: setAllergy
methods.description: Associates an allergy with this reaction.

methods.name: getReaction
methods.description: Returns the conceptual representation of the reaction.

methods.name: setReaction
methods.description: Sets the conceptual representation of the reaction.

methods.name: getReactionNonCoded
methods.description: Returns the non-coded textual description of the reaction.

methods.name: setReactionNonCoded
methods.description: Sets the non-coded textual description of the reaction.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the allergy reaction, prioritizing non-coded descriptions.

methods.name: hasSameValues
methods.description: Compares this allergy reaction with another to determine if their properties match.
